record.field: Rate to apply on the base salary for the social contribution computation for workers
CP302: 13th Month - Maternity Leave Calendar Limit

field.name: description
field.p: This calendar limit is used when assimilating maternity leaves during the 13th month computation.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Military Service Calendar Limit

field.name: description
field.p: This calendar limit is used when assimilating military service days during the 13th month computation.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Union Education Assimilable Days Limit

field.name: description
field.p: Max number of assimilable days per year for union education leaves.
The computation is on an hourly basis, so a limit of 10 would actually be 10 * average daily work hours

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Compelling Reason Assimilable Days Limit

field.name: description
field.p: Max number of assimilable days per year for compelling reasons.
The computation is on an hourly basis, so a limit of 10 would actually be 10 * average daily work hours

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Paternity Leave Assimilable Days Limit

field.name: description
field.p: Max number of assimilable days per year for paternity leaves.
The computation is on an hourly basis, so a limit of 10 would actually be 10 * average daily work hours

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Military Reserve Call Assimilable Days Limit

field.name: description
field.p: Max number of assimilable days per year for military reserve calls.
The computation is on an hourly basis, so a limit of 10 would actually be 10 * average daily work hours

record.field: # NOTE Can be 66 days depending if the employee participates in the # reservist formation, but we currently have no way to know that. 74
CP302: 13th Month - Sick Leaves Min Uninterrupted Period

field.name: description
field.p: Minimum consecutive duration for a sick leave to be assimilated for the cp302's thirteen month computation.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Sick Leaves Multi Assimilation Threshold

field.name: description
field.p: Any consecutive sick leave longer than this threshold can only be assimilated once during the cp302's 13th month computation.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Sick Leaves Max Year Assimilable Time

field.name: description
field.p: This is the maximum sick leave time that can be assimilated per year during the cp302's 13th month computation.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Sick Leaves Assimilation Rate

field.name: description
field.p: Rate at which assimilable sick days will be assimilated during the proratization computation of the cp302's 13th month

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Early Retirement Assimilation Rate

field.name: description
field.p: When personnel goes into early retirement, the retirement period up to the end of the year is assimilated at this rate during the 13th month computation.

field.name: description
field.p: Defines the assimilable time period after the death of the personnel during the 13th month computation
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Temporary Workers Min Worked Days In Year

field.name: description
field.p: Temporary workers who worked (prestated or assimilated days) less than the defined amount cannot get their 13th month

field.name: description
field.p: Personnel cannot get their 13th month if their seniority is less than the defined value
The limit will be interpreted using timedelta().

You can combine time fields together:
{'weeks': 7, 'days': 1} # 'months' and 'years' are not supported by timedelta()
Would represent a time limit of 7 weeks and 1 day.

record.field: {'weeks': (4 + 1 / 3) * 2} # The joint committee defines a month as 4.33.. weeks
CP302: 13th Month - Flexi Jobs Required Seniority

field.name: description
field.p: Flexi-Job personnel cannot get their 13th month if their seniority is less than the defined value
The limit will be interpreted using timedelta().

You can combine time fields together:
{'weeks': 7, 'days': 1} # 'months' and 'years' are not supported by timedelta()
Would represent a time limit of 7 weeks and 1 day.

record.field: {'weeks': (4 + 1 / 3) * 2} # The joint committee defines a month as 4.33.. weeks
CP302: 13th Month - Force Majeure Jobs Required Seniority

field.name: description
field.p: Personnel resigned due to force majeure cannot get their 13th month if their seniority is less than the defined value
The limit will be interpreted using timedelta().

You can combine time fields together:
{'weeks': 7, 'days': 1} # 'months' and 'years' are not supported by timedelta()
Would represent a time limit of 7 weeks and 1 day.

record.field: {'weeks': (4 + 1 / 3) * 2} # The joint committee defines a month as 4.33.. weeks
CP302: 13th Month - Fired Employee - Minimum Eligible Seniority In Year

field.name: description
field.p: Fired personnel can still get their 13th month if they worked at least the defined value of time during the current year.
The limit will be interpreted using timedelta().

You can combine time fields together:
{'weeks': 7, 'days': 1} # 'months' and 'years' are not supported by timedelta()
Would represent a time limit of 7 weeks and 1 day.

record.field: {'weeks': (4 + 1 / 3) * 2} # The joint committee defines a month as 4.33.. weeks
CP302: 13th Month - Serious Employer Misconduct - Minimum Eligible Seniority In Year

field.name: description
field.p: Resigned personnel due to a serious employer misconduct can still get their 13th month if they worked at least the defined value of time during the current year.
The limit will be interpreted using timedelta().

You can combine time fields together:
{'weeks': 7, 'days': 1} # 'months' and 'years' are not supported by timedelta()
Would represent a time limit of 7 weeks and 1 day.

record.field: {'weeks': (4 + 1 / 3) * 2} # The joint committee defines a month as 4.33.. weeks
CP302: 13th Month - Serious Employer Misconduct - Minimum Eligible Contract Duration

field.name: description
field.p: Fired personnel can still get their 13th month if their contract duration is of at least the defined value of time.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP200: 13th Month Departure - Required Seniority (Fired, Fired: Serious Misconduct, Retired, Early Retirement)

field.name: description
field.p: An employee fired, fired for serious misconduct, retired, or retiring early can get a prorated 13th month upon departure if their seniority is at least the defined value.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP200: 13th Month Departure - Required Seniority (Every Other Reason)

field.name: description
field.p: An employee departing for any reason other than being fired, fired for serious misconduct, retired, or retiring early can get a prorated 13th month upon departure if their seniority is at least the defined value.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().

record.field: CP302: 13th Month - Serious Employer Misconduct - Minimum Eligible Contract Duration

field.name: description
field.p: Resigned personnel due to a serious employer misconduct can still get their 13th month if their contract duration is of at least the defined value of time.
The limit will be interpreted using relativedelta().
